name: cove
description: Living desktop scenes for macOS: a fishable aquarium, a broom-chasing rabbit, a dress-up companion, and a sketchbook of little animals. Built on Desktop Habitats by Chase Lean.

scripts.check: node --check serve.mjs && for f in scenes/*/src/*.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.test: node scenes/riverscape/tests/fish-behavior.mjs && node scenes/riverscape/tests/render-policy.mjs && node scenes/riverscape/tests/plant-budget.mjs && node scenes/muse/tests/turntable.mjs && node scenes/critters/tests/sketchbook.mjs
